top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were not complete.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The guide was missing from the first aid kit.

top_violation_types.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs  - Fulcrum Seesaws (26 TAC §746.4605(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a fulcrum seesaw on the 3 and 4 year old playground.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Bean Bags, Waterbeds, Foam Pads As Sleeping Equipment (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, an infant was observed sleeping on a Boppy pillow.
